## Automated review
Found 2 issues in this PR:

[P1] Possible null dereference in `src/api/handler.js:42`
The response object may be null when the upstream times out.

[P2] Hardcoded retry limit constant in [deliveries/retry.js#L10](https://github.com/acme/widget/blob/abc123/deliveries/retry.js#L10)
Retry limits should come from configuration, not source.
